SELECT o.status, COUNT(*) n, SUM(r.refund_amount_twd) amt FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=r.order_id GROUP BY o.status

SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(p.amount_twd - t.item_twd) < 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) match_exact, SUM(CASE WHEN p.amount_twd > t.item_twd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) pay_gt, SUM(CASE WHEN p.amount_twd < t.item_twd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) pay_lt FROM payments p JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity*unit_price_cents/100.0) item_twd FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) t ON t.order_id=p.order_id WHERE p.payment_status='ok'

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_ts) utc_m, strftime('%Y-%m', datetime(order_ts,'+8 hours')) tpe_m, COUNT(*) n FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', order_ts) <> strftime('%Y-%m', datetime(order_ts,'+8 hours')) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT strftime('%Y', datetime(refund_ts,'+8 hours')) y, COUNT(*) n, SUM(refund_amount_twd) amt FROM refunds GROUP BY 1
SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN r.refund_ts < o.order_ts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) before_order FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=r.order_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id=o.order_id)

SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(r.refund_amount_twd) refund_twd, SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price_cents/100.0) item_twd, SUM(CASE WHEN r.refund_amount_twd > oi.quantity*oi.unit_price_cents/100.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over_refund, SUM(CASE WHEN r.refund_amount_twd = oi.quantity*oi.unit_price_cents/100.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) full_refund FROM refunds r JOIN order_items oi ON oi.item_id=r.item_id
SELECT o.status, COUNT(*) n, SUM(r.refund_amount_twd) amt FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=r.order_id GROUP BY o.status

SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(p.amount_twd - t.item_twd) < 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) match_exact, SUM(CASE WHEN p.amount_twd > t.item_twd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) pay_gt, SUM(CASE WHEN p.amount_twd < t.item_twd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) pay_lt FROM payments p JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity*unit_price_cents/100.0) item_twd FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) t ON t.order_id=p.order_id WHERE p.payment_status='ok'

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_ts) utc_m, strftime('%Y-%m', datetime(order_ts,'+8 hours')) tpe_m, COUNT(*) n FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', order_ts) <> strftime('%Y-%m', datetime(order_ts,'+8 hours')) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT strftime('%Y', datetime(refund_ts,'+8 hours')) y, COUNT(*) n, SUM(refund_amount_twd) amt FROM refunds GROUP BY 1

SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN r.refund_ts < o.order_ts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) before_order, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o2 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id=o2.order_id)) orders_without_items FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=r.order_id
SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN r.refund_ts < o.order_ts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) before_order FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=r.order_id
SELECT COUNT(*) orders_without_items FROM orders o2 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id=o2.order_id)

SELECT o.status, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN s.order_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) has_ship, SUM(CASE WHEN s.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) delivered FROM orders o LEFT JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY o.status
SELECT strftime('%Y', datetime(order_ts,'+8 hours')) y, COUNT(*) n FROM orders WHERE status IN (1,2,3) GROUP BY 1

SELECT COUNT(*) customers_valid, SUM(CASE WHEN c>=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) repeat_customers FROM (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) c FROM orders WHERE status IN (1,2,3) AND strftime('%Y', datetime(order_ts,'+8 hours'))='2025' GROUP BY customer_id)

SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours'))='2025' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) orders_2025, SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', datetime(r.refund_ts,'+8 hours'))='2026' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) refunds_in_2026 FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=r.order_id
SELECT COUNT(*) orders_without_items FROM orders o2 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id=o2.order_id)

SELECT p.category, COUNT(*) n, SUM(r.refund_amount_twd) amt FROM refunds r JOIN order_items oi ON oi.item_id=r.item_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY amt DESC

SELECT p.category, r.reason_code, SUM(r.refund_amount_twd) amt FROM refunds r JOIN order_items oi ON oi.item_id=r.item_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id WHERE r.reason_code='R2' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY amt DESC

SELECT p.is_active, COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id) products, SUM(oi.quantity) qty FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=oi.order_id WHERE o.status IN (1,2,3) GROUP BY 1
SELECT method, COUNT(*) n, SUM(amount_twd) amt FROM payments WHERE payment_status='ok' GROUP BY method ORDER BY amt DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y',datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours'))<>strftime('%Y',datetime(r.refund_ts,'+8 hours')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cross_year, SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m',datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours'))<>strftime('%Y-%m',datetime(r.refund_ts,'+8 hours')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cross_month FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=r.order_id
SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN oi.order_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_items FROM orders o LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT order_id FROM order_items) oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id

SELECT COUNT(*) n, ROUND(AVG(julianday(delivered_ts)-julianday(shipped_ts)),2) avg_days, SUM(CASE WHEN julianday(delivered_ts)-julianday(shipped_ts) <= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) on_time, SUM(CASE WHEN julianday(delivered_ts)<julianday(shipped_ts) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) negative FROM shipments WHERE delivered_ts IS NOT NULL

SELECT c.region_code, COUNT(*) valid_orders FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN (1,2,3) AND strftime('%Y',datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours'))='2025' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT c.tier, COUNT(*) valid_orders FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN (1,2,3) AND strftime('%Y',datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours'))='2025' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
SELECT channel, COUNT(*) valid_orders FROM orders WHERE status IN (1,2,3) AND strftime('%Y',datetime(order_ts,'+8 hours'))='2025' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN o.coupon_code='WELCOME10' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) welcome, SUM(CASE WHEN o.coupon_code='SUMMER15' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) summer, SUM(CASE WHEN o.coupon_code IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nocoupon, SUM(CASE WHEN oi.unit_price_cents = p.list_price_twd*100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) at_list FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id
